intro: Inspired by the timeless charm of park benches, Park City blends craftsmanship with elegance. A wide seat and an integrated wooden shelf create a relaxed chair, designed for unwinding in modern homes.

features.title: Elegant, minimalist design with contemporary appeal
features.text: Park City features a sleek, open form inspired by classic park benches. Its clean lines and balanced proportions elevate modern interiors without feeling overly plush or heavy.

features.title: Relaxed lounging comfort for everyday unwinding
features.text: Designed for laid-back seating, the chair offers supportive comfort without excess cushioning. Its wide stance and gently reclined posture make Park City ideal for reading, relaxing, or casual conversations.

features.title: Integrated wooden shelf for functional convenience
features.text: A built-in open shelf beneath the seat provides space for books, a laptop, or daily essentials. This thoughtful addition keeps everything within reach while maintaining a clean, organised look.

features.title: Acacia wood accents with a warm walnut finish
features.text: Visible wooden components are crafted from acacia wood with a mid-walnut stain. This warm finish adds natural richness and strengthens the overall aesthetic.

features.title: Smooth synthetic leather upholstery
features.text: Upholstered in synthetic leather, Park City offers a refined look that is easy to maintain. The chair’s material balances durability with everyday comfort.

features.title: Wide proportions for spacious seating
features.text: Generous dimensions enhance the chair’s comfort and allow a relaxed posture. Additionally, the open, bench-like structure makes it feel inviting and accessible.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
